### Download correct libraries ###
```{r}
## Load the haven package
library(haven)

# Import the dataset from the SAS file
sankey_cohort <- read_sas("/path/to/your/final_table (3).sas7bdat")

## Save the dataset as an .rds file
saveRDS(sankey_cohort, "/path/to/your/sankey_cohort.rds")
## Load the dataset from the .rds file
sankey_cohort <- readRDS("/path/to/your/sankey_cohort.rds")

## Library
library(ggplot2)
library(networkD3)
library(dplyr)
library(pander)
library(tidyr)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
```


### Sankey Diagram Using Network D3 Package ###
```{r}
## Reshape the data to long format and remove enrolid
links.df <- sankey_cohort %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("med_"), names_to = "column", values_to = "source") %>%
  filter(source != "" & !is.na(source)) %>%  # Filter out blank and NA values
  arrange(row, column)  # Ensure correct order

## Create target column
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(column = match(column, names(sankey_cohort))) %>%
  group_by(row) %>%
  mutate(target = lead(source, order_by = column)) %>%
  ungroup()

## Remove NAs in the target column unless the associated source column is Upadacitinib_1
links.df <- links.df %>%
  filter(!is.na(target) | column == "2")

## Add unique suffix to source and target
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(source = paste0(source, '_', column)) %>%
  mutate(target = paste0(target, '_', column + 1)) %>%
  select(row, column, source, target)

## Replace 'NA_3' values in the target column with 'Upadacitinib'
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(target = ifelse(target == "NA_3", "Upadacitinib", target))

## Create nodes data frame
nodes.df <- data.frame(name = unique(c(links.df$source, links.df$target)))

## Order nodes alphabetically
nodes.df <- nodes.df %>%
  arrange(name) %>%
  mutate(label = sub('_[0-9]*$', '', name))

## Add source_id and target_id to links
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(source_id = match(source, nodes.df$name) - 1,
         target_id = match(target, nodes.df$name) - 1,
         value = 1)

## Generate Sankey diagram
sankeyNetwork(Links = links.df,
              Nodes = nodes.df,
              Source = 'source_id',
              Target = 'target_id',
              Value = 'value',
              NodeID = 'label',
              fontSize = 16,
              nodeWidth = 30,
              nodePadding = 20,
              width = 1200,
              height = 800,
              iterations = 0,
              sinksRight = FALSE) %>%
    htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      d3.select(el).select('svg')
        .call(d3.zoom().on('zoom', function() {
          d3.select(el).select('svg g')
            .attr('transform', d3.event.transform);
        }));
    }
  ")
```


### Sankey Diagram Using Plotly Package ###
```{r}
## Reshape the data to long format and remove enrolid
links.df <- sankey_cohort %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("med_"), names_to = "column", values_to = "source") %>%
  filter(source != "" & !is.na(source)) %>%  # Filter out blank and NA values
  arrange(row, column)  # Ensure correct order

## Create target column
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(column = match(column, names(sankey_cohort))) %>%
  group_by(row) %>%
  mutate(target = lead(source, order_by = column)) %>%
  ungroup()

## Remove NAs in the target column unless the associated source column is Upadacitinib_1
links.df <- links.df %>%
  filter(!is.na(target) | column == "2")

## Add unique suffix to source and target
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(source = paste0(source, '_', column)) %>%
  mutate(target = paste0(target, '_', column + 1)) %>%
  select(row, column, source, target)

## Replace 'NA_3' values in the target column with 'Upadacitinib'
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(target = ifelse(target == "NA_3", "Upadacitinib", target))

## Create nodes data frame
nodes.df <- data.frame(name = unique(c(links.df$source, links.df$target)))
nodes.df$label <- sub('_[0-9]*$', '', nodes.df$name)

## Calculate outgoing and incoming counts for each node
outgoing_counts <- links.df %>%
  count(source) %>%
  rename(name = source, outgoing_count = n)

incoming_counts <- links.df %>%
  count(target) %>%
  rename(name = target, incoming_count = n)

## Combine counts
nodes.df <- nodes.df %>%
  left_join(outgoing_counts, by = "name") %>%
  left_join(incoming_counts, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(outgoing_count = ifelse(is.na(outgoing_count), 0, outgoing_count),
         incoming_count = ifelse(is.na(incoming_count), 0, incoming_count))

## Calculate total counts
total_count <- sum(nodes.df$outgoing_count) + sum(nodes.df$incoming_count)

## Calculate percentages
nodes.df <- nodes.df %>%
  mutate(outgoing_percentage = (outgoing_count / total_count) * 100,
         incoming_percentage = (incoming_count / total_count) * 100)

## Aggregate unique medications for each enrolid
agg_medications <- links.df %>%
  group_by(row) %>%
  summarize(all_medications = paste(unique(sub('_.*$', '', c(source, target))), collapse = ", "))

## Add source_id and target_id to links
links.df <- links.df %>%
  mutate(source_id = match(source, nodes.df$name) - 1,
         target_id = match(target, nodes.df$name) - 1,
         value = 1) %>%
  left_join(agg_medications, by = "row")

## Create Sankey diagram using Plotly
plot_ly(
  type = "sankey",
  orientation = "h",
  node = list(
    pad = 15,
    thickness = 20,
    line = list(color = "black", width = 0.5),
    label = nodes.df$label,
    customdata = nodes.df %>%
      select(incoming_count, incoming_percentage, outgoing_count, outgoing_percentage) %>%
      as.matrix(),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "%{label}<br>",
      "Incoming count: %{customdata[0]}<br>",
      "Outgoing count: %{customdata[2]}<br>",
      "Incoming percentage: %{customdata[1]}%<br>",
      "Outgoing percentage: %{customdata[3]}%<extra></extra>"
    )
  ),
  link = list(
    source = links.df$source_id,
    target = links.df$target_id,
    value = links.df$value,
    customdata = links.df$all_medications,
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "Medications: %{customdata}<extra></extra>"
    )
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Sankey Diagram: Lines of Therapy for Individual Biologics in Follow-up",
    font = list(size = 10),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "")
  )
```
